title: Sentences

near.sentenceGloss: The armchair stands near the wardrobe.

under.sentenceGloss: The cat sits under the table.

over.sentenceGloss: The picture hangs above the sofa.

behind.sentenceGloss: The coat rack stands behind the door.

before.sentenceGloss: A tree grows in front of the house.

kitchen.sentenceGloss: We prepare food in the kitchen.

attic.sentenceGloss: Old suitcases are stored in the attic.

floor.sentenceGloss: My flat is on the second floor.

summary: Location: біля + genitive; під, над, за, перед + instrumental; у/в, на + locative. These frames describe position.
